name: MERF Real-Time Rendering
definition: A real-time rendering implementation as a Javascript 3D (three.js) web application, orchestrated by a single GLSL fragment shader, using a multi-resolution hierarchy of occupancy grids for efficient ray marching.
summary: MERF Real-Time Rendering is a WebGL-based viewer that synthesizes views from Memory-Efficient Radiance Fields using multi-resolution occupancy grids for empty space skipping, prioritizing browser portability and memory efficiency over CUDA-based accelerators.
